proof:
# Centroid balance obstructs the proposed five-rectangle inside-cap strengthening

the contributor proposed balancing the full mixed centroid of the globally deepest
five-rectangle example, so that its constant weight would have a one-row
global parameter certificate. That particular adjustment fails exactly.
More strongly, the obstruction below applies to EVERY adjustment of the
three middle heights with the same contact pattern and zero base moment.
This does not rule out other shapes or other supporting-contact patterns.

## 1. An exact geometric obstruction for the whole five-rectangle class

Let P={-2,-1,0,1,2}, and let

    K_z=[-r_z/2,r_z/2] times [-H_z,H_z],
    r_z,H_z>0.

Assume these are actual compatible fibers if a mixed-body conclusion is
desired. The calculation itself uses only their actual rectangle measures.
Place the source at Y=(0,0,0), and suppose its physical vertical buffer is
delta>=0. Fix b>0, and consider the cap

    H_*={y-bz>=-delta}.                                (1)

Assume exactly the endpoint contact pattern

    H_-2=2b+delta,    H_2=2b-delta>0,                   (2)

so base -2 is fully captured with an inside supporting bottom facet,
and base+2 has only an outside supporting top facet. Assume also that
the three other traces are proper:

    |bz-delta|<H_z,   z=-1,0,1.                        (3)

Write the half base first moment

    B=sum_z z r_z H_z.

The actual original base mean is 2B/M, where M=2sum r_zH_z. Thus the
full mixed centroid is the source Y precisely when B=0; all continuous
fiber centroids are already zero.

First, local minimality of (1) under base-tilt changes NECESSARILY gives

    r_-1>=r_1.                                       (4)

Indeed write a=-b for the tilt in y+az+delta>=0 and decrease a slightly.
The left endpoint becomes strictly full and the right endpoint strictly
empty. The middle three remain proper. Their mass derivative with
respect to a is -r_-1+r_1, so the directional derivative for decreasing
a is r_-1-r_1. It must be nonnegative at a local minimum. The invariant
buffer does not change under this variation: its continuous normal is
fixed at (0,1), and the source and physical buffer are fixed.

Now choose a FINITE large positive tilt A such that

    A>max_z(H_z+delta).

The actual admissible buffered cap y+Az>=-delta has the two negative
base fibers empty, the two positive base fibers full, and the same
proper own trace as (1). Let R be its mass and Q the mass of (1). Exact
rectangle integration yields

    Q=2r_-2 H_-2
      +r_-1(H_-1+b+delta)+r_0(H_0+delta)
      +r_1(H_1-b+delta),
    R=2r_1H_1+2r_2H_2+r_0(H_0+delta),

and hence the identity

    R-Q = B-b(r_-1-r_1)-delta(r_-1+r_1).                (5)

No asymptotic tilt or boundary mass convention is used in this comparison.
All empty/full traces are strict for the displayed finite choice of A.

If B=0 and delta>0, local minimality (4) makes the right side of (5)
STRICTLY NEGATIVE. Thus (1) cannot be a globally minimizing buffered cap
at this source. This conclusion is independent of all three middle
heights, all volume ratios, and the choice of norm defining the buffer.

At delta=0, B=0, and global minimality, (4)--(5) instead force
r_-1=r_1. The same small negative tilt from the proof of (4) then leaves
the cap mass EXACTLY constant while making the two endpoint traces
strictly full/empty. It gives an inside-free minimizing cap. Thus this
same five-rectangle contact pattern does not supply an unbuffered
centroid-balanced unavoidable-inside example either.

## 2. the contributor's exact proposed adjustment

Keep eta=1/200, delta=1/4000, and

    r=(1,51/50,51/50,203/200,101/100).

Replace the previous height bump by

    a=(3/200-(403/40)/8000)/(409/200)=4397/654400,
    H_z=1-delta z/2+a(0,3,2,1,0)_z.

This gives the positive concave array

    H=(4001/4000,834591/818000,331597/327200,
       411697/409000,3999/4000).

Direct exact computation gives B=0 and

    M=835355607/81800000,
    Q=1668671531/327200000.

The candidate is (1) with b=1/2. The finite cap

    y+2z>=-delta

has all four non-own traces strictly saturated in the pattern used above,
and mass

    R=416921767/81800000.

Its exact deficit from the proposed candidate is

    R-Q=-2407/800000<0.                                (6)

Equivalently, (5) gives this immediately from B=0,
r_-1-r_1=1/200, and r_-1+r_1=407/200. Consequently the all-normal claim
fails before any oblique quadratic-cell analysis is needed.

## 3. Scope

The already proved globally deepest inside-facet example remains valid;
its full mixed centroid is not its unique deepest mark. The new result
blocks the proposed way of simultaneously imposing a single-source
constant-weight martingale certificate within this centered rectangular
contact class. It is not a counterexample to the global parameter
certificate theorem, nor an exclusion of inside facets for arbitrary
fixed-body parameter minima or joint body minima.

`../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_centroid_balanced_rectangle_inside_obstruction_two_sided.py`
checks the general identity symbolically, the exact adjusted body,
the finite competing cap statuses, and all proper minor quotas.
